async def act(page):
    # First, try to locate a search bar on the current page
    search_bar = page.get_by_role('searchbox') or page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search')
    if await search_bar.count() == 0:
        # If no search bar found, navigate to the homepage via the 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link
        await page.get_by_role('link', name='Epoch & Drift Benchmark').click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        # Now search for the search bar on the homepage
        search_bar = page.get_by_role('searchbox') or page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search')
    # Fill the search bar with 'GPT' and submit
    await search_bar.fill('GPT')
    await search_bar.press('Enter')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Identify the third search result. Assuming results are in list items or articles
    third_result = page.get_by_role('listitem').nth(2)  # Zero-indexed, nth(2) is the third item
    await third_result.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
